state.paragraph: Two of the bidders (one of which had been invited into the final round but had indicated a desire to work with an equity partner in light of the size of an acquisition of PetSmart, and the other of which had indicated to J.P. Morgan that it would drop out of the process if not permitted to work together with another bidder) requested permission to work together. These two bidders informed J.P. Morgan that they had worked together successfully in previous large leveraged buyouts. After deliberation and consultation with the Company's financial and legal advisors, the ad hoc committee authorized these two bidders to work together. We refer to these two bidders together as "Bidder 3." Each of the bidders invited into the final round indicated some interest in a Longview rollover, though each also stated that its bid would not be conditioned or dependent on Longview participation.

ledger_rows.Note: Six of the potentially interested parties submitted indications of interest.
Preliminary non-binding indication; range $81.00–$83.00; consideration not stated.
Another of the six submitters; non-binding range $80.00–$85.00; not individually named.
Remainder of the six submitters; no individual detail or prices; one later advanced, two eliminated 11/03 (#24).
Raised after J.P. Morgan's 10/30–11/02 calls; range $81.00–$84.00; made it one of four at or above $80.00.
Final round opened by the 11/03 advancement of four bidders at or above $80.00; merger-agreement form circulated in November; updated FY2014 projections given to all finalists.
6 submitters − 4 advanced = 2 notified as eliminated; none could remain above their initial indications.

adviser.instructions: `paragraph` reports that a financial or legal adviser is retained, engaged, terminated or first shown acting for the target, a committee or a bidder. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
